releases.name: opencode-voice v0.2.3
releases.body:
## Fixed

- Repaired unfinalized WAV headers before transcription so recordings interrupted by forced recorder termination remain usable (#4).
- Hardened RIFF chunk parsing and added focused regression tests.

Thanks to @clintonwanner for reporting the issue and contributing the fix in #4.

releases.name: opencode-voice v0.2.2
releases.body:
## OpenCode 1.18 compatibility

- Restored the TUI-only plugin export required by OpenCode 1.18.
- Includes the `v0.2.0` Handy catalog and GigaAM models.

releases.name: opencode-voice v0.2.1
releases.body:
## OpenCode 1.18 compatibility

- Added the required no-op server export so the TUI voice plugin can load in OpenCode 1.18 and later.
- Includes all `v0.2.0` managed transcription engines and Handy catalog models, including GigaAM.

releases.name: opencode-voice v0.2.0
releases.body:
## Managed transcription engines

- Added the managed Rust `transcribe-cpp` sidecar and 68 verified GGUF ASR models from Handy's catalog, including GigaAM, Parakeet, Moonshine, Canary, SenseVoice, Qwen, Voxtral, and Granite.
- Added install, status, import, remove, and diagnostics commands for managed `whisper.cpp` and `transcribe-cpp` engines.
- Added `opencode-voice update` for updating an installed plugin.

## Voice workflow improvements

- Reorganized settings around one recording key and grouped transcription and system settings.
- Hold-to-talk is shown as unavailable until OpenCode exposes reliable terminal key-release events to TUI plugins.
- Expanded Windows recorder diagnostics with the exact `ffmpeg` command and captured stderr.
- Improved Windows microphone fallback handling and expanded the built-in Whisper model picker.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ihxnnxs/opencode-voice/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.

Fix Windows managed whisper.cpp engine install by shipping a static MinGW-built whisper-cli.exe that does not require Visual C++ runtime DLLs. Also fixes managed engine downloadDir handling and stream-stall timeout diagnostics.
